overview: DhobiGhat is a premium laundry and dry cleaning booking platform for Mumbai-based customers. Users can schedule pickups, track their laundry requests, view pricing, and pay via UPI — all from a mobile-friendly web app. Admins manage orders, prices, payments, and customer loyalty discounts.
features: Splash hero page with sliding background carousel and service highlights
5 service types: Dry Cleaning, Wash & Steam Iron, Wash & Fold, Shoe Cleaning, Steam Iron
7-day pickup scheduler with time slots and express service toggle
Phone number registration with OTP verification
User dashboard with saved addresses and pickup management
My Request List with admin-controlled status tracking (Pickup Done, Drop Done)
Full price list with 5 category tabs (Men, Women, Kids, Household, Shoes)
UPI payment integration with configurable payment ID
Separate admin login with rate management, order tracking, payment verification
Loyalty tier automation with auto-discount at checkout
Fully configurable assets, images, logo, and backend URLs for GoDaddy migration
